text:
sam: Heads-up — we need to soft-disable feature flag `model-routing-v3` during tonight's 00:30 UTC deploy. Observed surge on canary yesterday, want to avoid noisy failure storm. Plan: 00:20 start soft-disable (95% -> 0 over 10m), pin routing to v2 snapshot, deploy, then re-ramp if healthy. Any objections?
maria: ack. can you add rollback criteria? e.g. 5xx rate > 1% OR median p95 latency increase > 200ms over baseline for 5m.
leo: +1 to criteria. Suggest we also add a short hold at 30% traffic for 10m to validate KV cache warmup.
sam: good call. updated plan: 95%->30% over 5m, hold 10m, then 30%->0 over 5m. pin to v2-2026-03-18-rc3 during the window.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by @sam for 2026-03-21 00:30 UTC. Automated FF step: initiating gradual toggle per policy ff-safety-softdown. Logs: `ff.toggle.start(model-routing-v3, actor=sam)`
irene: putting a short note into release notes: "Temporarily disabling model-routing-v3 to mitigate canary surge; routing pinned to v2 snapshot. Will re-enable if diagnostics look green." cc @support
ops-oncall: I will monitor traces + error budget during the hold. If 5xx spikes, I will request immediate rollback (pin back to v2 and abort deploy). Please keep pager routing unchanged.
maria: quick checklist for the deploy: 1) create rollback tag (`pin-v2-before-deploy`) 2) run smoke tests against v2 pin 3) verify canary tracing spans show KV hits >80% 4) confirm alerting thresholds are set
sam: doing step 1 now: `git tag pin-v2-before-deploy v2-2026-03-18-rc3`
deploy-bot: ff toggle progress: 95%->30% initiated. `ff.toggle.progress( model-routing-v3, from=95, to=30, duration=300s )`
leo: seeing a few minor errors in canary but within baseline. hold for 10m starting now.
ops-oncall: hold started. watching `p95_latency`, `5xx_rate`, `trace_error_rate`. will update in 5m.
maria: added release_notes entry to the internal release doc and to the public changelog draft. snippet: "Temporary soft-disable of model-routing-v3 during deploy; routing pinned to v2-2026-03-18-rc3 to ensure stability."
sam: after hold, if metrics stable, proceed 30%->0. If any alert fires, we abort and roll back to pinned tag. no other changes planned.
deploy-bot: hold period complete. no automated alerts detected. initiating final drain 30%->0. `ff.toggle.finish(model-routing-v3)`
leo: final metrics look green. KV cache warmed. 
ops-oncall: no 5xx spike, latency within +50ms. all good from SRE.
sam: re-enable task: we'll leave a canary for 1 hour before re-enabling v3 permanently. reopening a follow-up thread to coordinate re-ramp tomorrow morning. thanks team :thumbsup:
maria: noted for release notes and support comms.
deploy-bot: deploy completed successfully. `deploy.status(success)`
